about_the_game:
The village of Nekomura lives its life, quiet and carefree. You will have to find all the hidden objects in this area to make this black and white world painted in bright colors and come to life. It's up to you to decide which items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family

Game features:

- 150 search items

- Ability to choose the desired item to search for

- Increasing level of difficulty

- There is a hint

- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings

- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell

- Coloring levels

- 2.5D effect

name: FIND ALL 7: Japan - Extra Level
short_description: In Find All 7: Japan - Extra level you will explore the peaceful and cozy village of Nekomura, hidden in the shadow of the mountains from the hustle and bustle of the city. Look for the hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.
